citation_and_novelty_lock.bell_ghioca: Bell--Ghioca Theorem 1.1(i) is fixed-orbit rational-self-map return-time structure for a finitely generated subgroup; under the regular-self-map hypothesis Theorem 1.1(ii) makes only the residual set finite. H on G_m^2 is generally rational rather than regular.
citation_and_novelty_lock.bounded_collision_statement: A targeted primary-source search through 2026-08-16 located no theorem combining the locked monomial Henon family, arbitrary finite-rank groups, a coefficient-uniform four-transition bound, and rank-one three-transition failure; this is not an absolute priority claim.
citation_and_novelty_lock.ess: Evertse--Schlickewei--Schmidt, published Theorem 1.1, is the sole imported external proof theorem.
citation_and_novelty_lock.kim_krieger_postolache_szeto: Theorem A is for odd d>2, a rational polynomial of degree at most d, and at least (d-4)^2 rational periodic points in a general-polynomial Henon family; Theorem B for d congruent to 1 modulo 6 gives an integer cycle of length (8d+10)/3.
citation_and_novelty_lock.mello_yasufuku: Theorems 1.1--1.2 and Corollary 1.3 are conditional on Hyp_epsilon with epsilon>=(1+c)/2; Theorem 4.2 under additional divisor hypotheses and Vojta supplies only sufficiently small epsilon and does not verify the general main hypothesis.
citation_and_novelty_lock.novelty_score: 7.0/10 advisory governance provenance only; not theorem evidence or publication prose

limitations_lock: ESS exponential constant is coarse and unoptimized.
The 81*d^2 union bound is coarse and unoptimized.
No complete T_2/T_3 coefficient stratification is claimed.
No theorem for general polynomial Henon maps, compositions, or arbitrary polynomial automorphisms is claimed.
The result is a finite-window theorem, not a return-time classification.
PC2 is sharp only in transition length, not in numerical constants.
The periodic corollary requires whole-orbit containment.
Degree d=1, positive characteristic, and zero coefficients are excluded.
No effective enumeration, height bound, rational or integral point classification, or periodicity of the sharp family is claimed.

degeneracy.BA: only potentially free adjacent chain; every branch closes at the third letter with at most d^2 initial states
degeneracy.CB: only potentially free adjacent chain; CBB and CBC close at the third letter and only CBA can remain free
degeneracy.CBA: free only under a=-1 and b*c^(d-1)=-1; closes at the fourth letter with at most d^2 initial states
degeneracy.indexing_direction: first letter at i, then i+1, i+2, i+3
degeneracy.simultaneous_degeneracy: choose any valid label at each index; overlaps can overcount but cannot omit a point
degeneracy.total: 3^4=81 words, each at most d^2 initial states, hence at most 81*d^2

safe_title: Four-Step Escape from Finite-Rank Tori for Monomial Henon Maps

theorem_lock.T_m_definition: T_m(H,Gamma)={P in Gamma^2: H^j(P) is in Gamma^2 for every integer j with 0<=j<=m}
theorem_lock.coefficients: a,b,c in K^*; no coefficient-membership assumption in Gamma
theorem_lock.field: K is an arbitrary field of characteristic zero
theorem_lock.finite_rank_group: Gamma<=K^* has finite rank r; finite generation is not assumed
theorem_lock.periodic_corollary: If C_n^Gamma(H) counts exact-period-n H-orbits O with the whole orbit O contained in Gamma^2, then sum_(n>=1) n*C_n^Gamma(H)<=4*d*exp(18^9*(3*r+1))+81*d^2.

rank_one_T3_sharpness.statement: For every integer d>=2 there is a number-field example with rank(Gamma)=1 and infinitely many points in T_3(H,Gamma).

theorem_lock.window_semantics: T_4 has five states and four transitions/local equations; T_3 has four states and three transitions.
